user_request: Test the paper's core relay-delivery idea with a controlled comparison.
user_selected_scale: Three seeds, four scenarios, 240 seconds each; approximately 48 minutes of sequential solving.
paired_design: 2x2 relay enabled/disabled within origin and fixed predeployment home configurations.
timing_boundary: Input, network, deployment, common DIRECT construction, all solver phases, validation and JSON artifacts included; imports excluded.
existing_phase_policy: 95% DIRECT warmup on full relay Problem; no post-result tuning.
prefix_limitation: A relay registry adds plan-index and evaluation overhead even when relay_enabled=False in warmup; identical search prefixes are not assumed.
model_boundary: Paper extension: K counts final responsibility, inbound transport not counted; asynchronous fixed-station transfer, unlimited station cache, zero handling time.
counterfactual_boundary: Fixed final responsibility and remaining event order; converted to DIRECT without reoptimization or extra optimizer run.
historical_boundary: Prior different objectives, code snapshots and unequal modular budgets do not enter new paired statistics.
during_timers: Only reading and text/code editing; no tests, audits, report rendering, browser QA or additional optimization.
interpretation: All wins, ties and losses retained; performance, actual cross-UAV use and fixed-structure contribution are separate evidence layers.
preflight: 54 tiny synthetic/worker checks and reversible-source, six-execution-file, 12-cell and within-pair home/network/initial fingerprint checks completed before first timer.
reporting_resume: User resumed remaining report work after explicit pause; report and Matplotlib figures use only the 12 completed and audited runs. No new solver invocation or parameter adjustment.
